text:
maria.g: heads-up — planning a small night window for the kernel shim + quant build drain + rollout. target window 02:00-03:00 UTC. will do a 5% canary -> 25% -> 100% if signals look good. pinging night ops.

deploybot: [scheduled] release job created: rb/quant-shim-2026-03-21 (canary 5%). ETA start 02:00 UTC.

ben: noted. who owns the release notes and the compatibility blurb for fallbacks?

carla: I can take release notes. need the exact fallback variant name — is it engine:v1-compat or the newer v1-compat-lite?

alex.k: use engine:v1-compat-lite for thermal nodes, v1-compat for standard. plan is: canary on standard pool, then thermal pool using lite. rollback criteria: >5% error rate increase OR median p50 latency +50ms for 10m window.

maria.g: perfect. ben — can you confirm pin TTL on the canary? we don't want sticky pins causing leftover traffic after midnight.

ben: setting pin TTL=2h on canary, automatic unpin at 04:15 UTC if not promoted. will attach to deploybot command.

deploybot: command received: /release start rb/quant-shim-2026-03-21 --canary=5 --ttl=2h --notify #eng-runtime

alex.k: quick snippet for traffic shift if someone needs to run manual:
```
# ephemeral traffic shift
curl -X POST https://api.redwood/release/shift \ 
  -d '{"release":"rb/quant-shim-2026-03-21","to":25}' \ 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $DEPLOY_TOKEN'
```

sre-oncall: will be watching. oncall PagerDuty is paged for any error-rate spike >5% and latency SLO breach. my number in thread: sam (sre-oncall).

carla: grabbing release note skeleton now. maria, if you can drop the kernel ABI bullet and the quant flags we changed, I’ll publish before the 02:00 start.

maria.g: adding ABI note and flags: --quantize=int8-v2, --kv-cache=optimized, shim flag --enable-sigil-evict. posting in 2m. :thumbsup:

ben: one more ask — enable fallback routing to engine:v1-compat by default during the 5% canary, so noisy customers hit fallback immediately. will patch routing policy.

alex.k: done. routing policy updated: canary bucket -> primary shim; on error -> route to v1-compat. test smoke ok in staging.

deploybot: [running] canary rollout started at 02:00 UTC. canary set at 5%. monitoring endpoints: /metrics/release/rb/quant-shim-2026-03-21.

maria.g: thanks everyone. notify here if you see anything weird. if clean at +20m we move to 25%.

sre-oncall: saw a tiny p95 blip at +6m (20ms). not alarming, holding watch.

ben: :ok_hand: moving to 25% in 10m unless we get >5% errors.

carla: release notes published: https://docs.internal/releases/rb-quant-shim-2026-03-21 — cc: product and support.

maria.g: excellent. closing loop after final promotion.

deploybot: [status] 25% shift started at 02:25 UTC.

sre-oncall: marking channel as monitored. no alerts so far.

maria.g: final note — after full promotion, remember to clear the canary pin and update the runbook with the final build hash.

ben: will clear pin at 04:10 UTC and post final build hash.`
